summary: On cross-era parity FAIL the run aborts (exit 3) instead of auto-re-extracting L1/L2 fleet-wide; the fallback is an orchestrator re-dispatch decision (plan v4 amends this as the registered behavior).
Phase-D C7 rejects the Phase-A generation JSON shape (no targets map; parser crashes on metadata keys) — production fits crash at C7 after the expensive phases. Fix both sides + unit test.
Plan v4 registers abort-and-orchestrator-redispatch as the designed behavior; the diff implements exactly that (exit-3 abort, persisted residuals). Both reviewers verified.
Fixed both sides (targets map in Phase-A payload + responses-list routing in _texts_from_json) + 9/9 unit tests pinning the shapes; commit 29b9ea818c. Round-2 reviewers verify.
m0/shift floors fit rank-deficient targets (V0 centered rank~29 < 64): ~35/64 PCA dims are SVD null-basis noise, possibly inflating the floor; exact batching impossible (stays serial).
